matrix.testAmendment: Only graph-contained-recovery.test.ts changed after broad matrix; final full72 rerun. Source hashes are explicitly different for this one test file.

judgments.summary: FIFO rejected via O_NONBLOCK open + fstat isFile without waiting for a writer; reads hard-capped at 65537 bytes across short reads and post-stat growth; closeSync in finally closes the descriptor on all paths, confirmed by tests and the unmocked FIFO probe.

Identity, canonical bytes, scope, inventory, grants, ledger binding, and transactional recheck checks are unchanged in the current module; recovery store still throws on any commit and no settlement, release, or replay behavior was added.

Tests cover reopen and final transaction stages, FIFO rejection with a fail-fast mock guard, discriminating post-stat growth (RED on old reader), exact 65536 boundary under forced short reads, and descriptor closure on read error; mocks pass through to real OS calls and an unmocked probe corroborates real FIFO behavior without overclaiming full-graph proof.

findings.message: closeSync in finally could theoretically mask the original rejection error if close itself throws; cosmetic and not blocking.

Post-stat growth is simulated via an fstat mock because a real growth race is not deterministically testable; acceptable given the discriminating RED evidence and the unmocked FIFO probe covering real-OS behavior.
findings.evidence: stat.size kept at original.length while real file grows to 65537 bytes
